title: Implant indications and alien dyes found on Eric Mitchell

tellings.quote: but yeah I saw some indications of implants and and Eric and uh we found some dies on them recently.

plain: A man named Eric Mitchell shows signs of having objects implanted in his body, and dyes were recently found on him, according to Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies what he takes to be alien implants in human bodies. Colbern tells Michels he saw the signs himself and worked on the dye finding with Mitchell. If true, it would point to physical traces left on people who say they were taken.
